askCmdr.forget.title: Forget everything Cmdr remembers about you?
askCmdr.forget.message: Cmdr throws away its notes about you and starts from a blank page. Your chats and your files stay exactly as they are.
askCmdr.cost.estimateTooltip: The amount is in USD, and it doesn’t count caching on your provider’s side. Your real bill is probably a fraction of this, because the context shared between our calls is cached.
askCmdr.cost.label: This chat’s usage
